description: Small foundation libraries for .NET: host setups, startup gates, metrics helpers, backoff and Akka.NET helpers (Terp, Terp.Akka).
rules: List setups explicitly and call builder.Setup(...) in the order they should run; there is no discovery or ordering attribute.
A setup implements ISetup<TTarget> once per part of the host it changes, and Setup(target, context) is always the method name.
Register startup gates with services.AddStartupGate(...); gates run while the host starts and are retried with exponential backoff.
Terp.Akka allows one actor system per host: derive from ActorSystemSetup and add actors in BuildSystem.
